basics.name: Jordan Rivera
basics.label: Senior Software Engineer
basics.summary: Senior software engineer with 7+ years building reliable, high-traffic web platforms. Specialised in TypeScript, Go and cloud infrastructure; led teams of up to six engineers and shipped products used by 2M+ people. Comfortable owning systems end-to-end, from data model to on-call.

work.name: Northwind Analytics
highlights: Led the migration of a 400k-line monolith to 14 Go services on Kubernetes, cutting p95 latency by 48% and infra cost by $310k/year
Designed an event-sourced billing pipeline processing 12M events/day with exactly-once guarantees
Mentored 5 engineers; introduced design reviews that halved production incidents quarter over quarter
Partnered with product and data science to launch usage-based pricing, adding $4.2M ARR in the first year

work.name: Brightline Health
highlights: Built a HIPAA-compliant patient messaging platform in TypeScript and PostgreSQL serving 300k monthly users
Reduced page load time by 62% through code splitting, image CDN and query optimisation
Owned the CI/CD pipeline (GitHub Actions, Terraform), taking deploys from weekly to 20+ per day

work.name: Pixel & Pine Studio
highlights: Delivered 25+ responsive client sites and a shared component library adopted across all projects
Implemented accessibility fixes reaching WCAG 2.1 AA on every new build
